name: Budesonide (inhaled)
dosing: Dose varies by device and indication; low-medium-high dosing tiers for asthma
contraindications: Not to be used as the sole therapy in acute severe asthma exacerbations; hypersensitivity to budesonide
interactions: Systemic corticosteroid interactions and potential increased systemic effects with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors
monitoring: Assess inhaler technique, symptom control and growth in children on higher doses; monitor for oral candidiasis and advise mouth rinsing or spacer use
pregnancy: Budesonide is often preferred as the inhaled corticosteroid of choice in pregnancy when maintenance ICS therapy is required
sideEffects: Local: oral candidiasis, dysphonia; systemic effects uncommon at low–moderate inhaled doses but possible at high doses or with potent CYP3A4 inhibition
clinicalPearls: Mainstay maintenance therapy for asthma; select device and dose based on severity and patient ability; use spacer and mouth rinse to reduce local side effects
indication: Maintenance anti-inflammatory therapy for asthma; may be considered in selected patients with COPD when indicated
